Runes of Swordsmanship provide fixture attribute bonuses for Swordsmanship.

*A Warrior Rune of Minor Swordsmanship provides +1 Swordsmanship.
*A Warrior Rune of Major Swordsmanship provides +2 Swordsmanship and -35 health.
*A Warrior Rune of Superior Swordsmanship provides +3 Swordsmanship and -75 health.

The Swordsmanship bonus is non-stacking, but the health penalty stacks.
